Operational handbook: the long-form edition

By Jordan Lee · 64 min read

Scheduler deep dive, part 1

The scheduler subsystem processes requests through a pipeline of 8 stages, each one responsible for a narrow slice of the overall contract. In practice operators observe that latency concentrates in the middle stages, where [backpressure](/docs/backpressure) accumulates when downstream capacity fluctuates. The remainder of this section walks through the mitigation strategies in decreasing order of effectiveness, with worked examples for each configuration knob and a short discussion of failure modes.
